title: ci(ui-merge): the 19 objectui repo gates in `ui/.github/workflows/repo-gates.yml` have run nowhere since the cutover — port them into the root `Lint UI` job before 2d-3 deletes the nested workflows (roster row 24; parent #25677)
body:
Filing gate ④ (承父单: aftercare of the ui/ merge, #25752 → #25677) + ①-adjacent: a gate population with a named landing point that has been silently unrun since `fd40831416`. Part of #25712 (4b: governance scripts in-tree; the #25697 workflow roster's **row 24** reads "`repo-gates.yml` → sub-issue 4, its doc/skill type gates may move into Lint UI"). Part of #25677. ⛔ Not a claim: the coordinator opens the card thread. Touches `.github/workflows/ci.yml` = Tier H: GOVERNED_APPROVERS review, the PR stops at draft.

**谁付代价（业务筛）:** the shipped surfaces. These gates judge `ui/content/docs/**` (the @object-ui docs site), `ui/skills/**` (the shipped skill guides) and the component registry's documented types — 出货面 under North Star item 4. In the objectui repo every pull request ran them (`repo-gates.yml`, no path filter by design). Since the cutover (#25825, 2026-10-25 22:51Z) GitHub runs only the root `.github/workflows/`, and the root `ci.yml` runs none of these 19 aliases, so a doc example with a wrong component type, a skill guide citing a dead path, or a prompt-taught component key that does not render would land on `main` unseen. Their test files still judge the live tree inside Test UI, so some protection remains, but as pull-request gates they are unrun.

## Measured (2026-10-26 02:30Z, `main` `c475b45b56`; the 2d-2 seat's command diff, re-read by the epic PM)

`ui/.github/workflows/repo-gates.yml` runs, per step name:
`check-control-bytes`, `check-action-ref-convention`, pre-install import graph (`check-pre-install-import-graph`), `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-doc-links` (`docs:check-links`), doc fence languages, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-component-types`, `check-prompt-component-keys`, `check-skills-paths`, `check-skill-eval-tokens` (`--self-test` + run), `check:docs-route-closure`, `check-skill-examples` (`--self-test` + run, against built types), `check-doc-snippet-types` (`--emit-census` + run, + JSDoc `@example` compile), `check-readme-exports`, doc JSON fences.

The root `ci.yml` `pnpm --dir ui run …` set (31 aliases: `lint-ui`'s `lint:root`, `lint:coverage`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:bash32-floor`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:test-source-alias`; `type-check-ui`'s phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, metadata-write-doors, published-tsconfig-exclude, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, esm-specifiers, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, the three i18n gates, the four type-check programs; `test-ui`'s `test`; `build-e2e-ui`'s `test:e2e`) contains **none of the 19**.

The nested `repo-gates.yml` also runs `node scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs build` before install — the deleted script that reds Test UI 8/16 today (2c #25861's leftover row); the port drops that step, since the merged tree builds `@objectstack/*` from the workspace.

## Wanted

1. One `Lint UI`-side home for the 19 gates in the root `ci.yml`: either new steps in `lint-ui` (pre-install gates first, as `repo-gates.yml` orders them, then the install, then the gates that need built types after a `turbo run build` of the packages they read — `repo-gates.yml` lines 315–490 give the order and the `SKILL_FILTER` / `SNIPPET_FILTER` derivation), or a new `repo-gates-ui` job under the same `ui` filter output. The seat picks by measured duration and writes the number; the maintainer's ruling 2026-10-25 Q6-b (push-to-main runs stay) holds either way.
2. Every ported step keeps its `<check> — <step>` name shape so the ui step-collector tests (`ci-setup-pnpm-wiring`, `check-*-workflow` pins) can be retargeted by 2d-2/2d-3 to the root job by path, the way #25879 does for `type-check-ui`.
3. If the home is a new job: a `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` decision is NOT this card's — note it for the maintainer in the 维护者速读 and leave the required set alone.
4. The gate rosters follow (`check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-expected-skips`, `check-step-collectors`, `check-aggregator-roster`); each `--self-test` exits 0.

⛔ Not here: deleting `ui/.github/workflows/**` (2d-3 on #25712 does it, after this lands — tell the 2b thread the PR number); the other unrun nested workflows (lockfile-dedupe/integrity rows 18/19, node-esm-load 21, performance-budget 22, published-dist 23, required-check-set 25, governed-queue-guard 11, merge-queue-head 20, line-citation 15, changeset trio 3/4) — each stays its roster row.

## Acceptance

- A ui PR that breaks one gate (e.g. a doc example naming a component type the registry lacks) shows `Lint UI` red with that step's name; a clean ui PR shows it green. On the card: the `Lint UI` job duration before and after, and the run ids.
- The 2b thread's 2d-2 PR can retire or retarget the 19 gates' "has a workflow that gates pull requests" pins against the root job instead of against row 24.

**Size:** M. **Priority:** p2 (shipped-surface gates unrun; a one-line wrong claim in docs or skills is North Star item 4). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none. **Who acts:** a domain:devx card thread (concurrency 6 has one seat free after #25867/#25868); edits only the `lint-ui` region of `ci.yml`, so it runs in parallel with #25867 (`filter`) and #25868 (`test-ui`).

## Dedupe

`search_issues` 2026-10-26 02:31Z: `is:open "repo-gates"` → 0; `is:open "Lint UI" gates port ui` → 0; the broad 「repo-gates.yml Lint UI port gates」 → 130 hits, top 10 all closed dispatch-gates findings, none about this workflow. Roster row 24 on #25697 (comment 6388182608) is the only prior mention and names this as a follow-up without a card. **New.**
